other_conditions: Must have contributed at least 10 years in Goa as a practising artist
Award will not be presented posthumously except if death occurs after the name has been recommended, in which case it may be presented posthumously
benefits_summary: Awardees receive a shawl, a sriphal, a certificate of appreciation, a cash prize of ₹1,00,000 and monthly financial assistance under the Kala Samman scheme.
